title: AUTH-087 controlled suspension expires session

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context

steps.title: Install clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 07:59:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
Pause clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 08:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And access A expires at controlled time T+900 seconds; refresh R expires at T+13524 seconds
4. And suspension starts at controlled time T; browser timers do not execute during suspension
5. When the browser remains suspended for exactly 4 hours and 1 millisecond

steps.title: Set system time "Tue Jan 01 2030 12:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 6. And the browser changes this page from hidden to visible
7. And the controlled browser clock advances through the 1000-millisecond logout delay
8. Then the textbox with placeholder "Enter Username" on the login page is visible
9. And the text input with placeholder "Enter Password" on the login page is visible
10. And the button labelled "Sign In" on the login page is visible
11. And the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is absent
12. And the dialog named "Your session has been expired" on the Home page is absent
13. And the browser records exactly 0 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/relogin"
14. And the browser records exactly 0 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/extend"
15. And the installed access credential is absent

annotations.description: Actual MFE; controlled API responses, clock, visibility and suspension adapters. Unsigned browser-only credentials. No natural lifecycle, real identity or service policy acceptance.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
